def solve_n_5():
    m = 10
    sums_range = list(range(1, m + 1))
    
    # Indices for p:
    # 0: s12, 1: s13, 2: s14, 3: s15, 4: s23, 5: s24, 6: s25, 7: s34, 8: s35, 9: s45
    
    for p in itertools.permutations(sums_range):
        # Conditions:
        # K_1234: s12+s34 = s13+s24 = s14+s23
        # K_1235: s12+s35 = s13+s25 = s15+s23
        # K_1245: s12+s45 = s14+s25 = s15+s24
        # K_1345: s13+s45 = s14+s35 = s15+s34
        # K_2345: s23+s45 = s24+s35 = s25+s34
        if (p[0] + p[7] == p[1] + p[5] == p[2] + p[4] and
            p[0] + p[8] == p[1] + p[6] == p[3] + p[4] and
            p[0] + p[9] == p[2] + p[6] == p[3] + p[5] and
            p[1] + p[9] == p[2] + p[8] == p[3] + p[7] and
            p[4] + p[9] == p[5] + p[8] == p[6] + p[7]):
            
            # Calculate a_i
            # a1+a2=p0, a1+a3=p1, a2+a3=p4
            a1 = (p[0] + p[1] - p[4]) / 2.0
            a2 = p[0] - a1
            a3 = p[1] - a1
            a4 = p[2] - a1
            a5 = p[3] - a1
            A = [a1, a2, a3, a4, a5]

                    return A
    return None
